seo.title: Compare PDF — See What Changed Between Two Files | JPdf
seo.description: Compare two PDF files and see exactly what changed — both a text-level diff and a page-by-page visual diff, clearly labeled as the two different things they are. Free, fast, and private.

subtitle: See what changed between two versions of a PDF — as text and visually.

howItWorks.title: How to compare two PDFs
steps: Upload the original file, then the revised version.
Download a report showing the text differences and a page-by-page visual diff.

items.q: What's the difference between the text diff and the visual diff?
items.a: The text diff compares the words extracted from each document — it catches wording changes but nothing about layout or appearance. The visual diff renders each page as an image and compares it pixel by pixel — it catches font, image, and layout changes a text diff can't see, but can also flag differences a text diff wouldn't. They're genuinely different comparisons, shown separately, not combined into one score.

items.q: What if the two files have different numbers of pages?
items.a: The text diff still compares the full content of both files. The visual, page-by-page diff only compares the pages both files have in common; the report notes how many extra pages the longer file has.

items.q: Which file should I upload first?
items.a: Upload the original (older) version first, then the revised (newer) version second — the report labels differences as additions or removals based on that order.

items.q: Will my files be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Both files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
